event_summary: An orange basketball-like ball on outdoor ground has yellow-orange flames along its right side while a metal nozzle with a small blue flame points toward it.
raw_event_description: The video begins with the ball already in view on soil and pine needles, with a yellow-orange flame on its right side and a torch-like nozzle at the right edge aimed toward it. Over time the yellow-orange flame flickers, grows taller, and extends above the top of the ball, sometimes leaning toward the upper left. The ball stays in roughly the same position and keeps an overall round outline, while the right-front surface is repeatedly obscured by flame. Later, dark vertical marks become visible on the lower-right/front printed area of the ball. The nozzle remains near the right edge with a small blue flame at its tip, with slight visible shifts in its position.

reasons: The ball, surrounding ground, right-side flame, and nozzle are visible in the first frame.
The flame is already present at the start, so no pre-flame state is shown.
